race.comment: STORMING HOME (11) returns and makes her stable debut for the sharp Jack Bruce yard. Has trialled well in readiness and gets a key booking in Maloney. Bright start anticipated. PREETHICAL (13) is a first starter by Graff from Unswerving who has thrown plenty of winners to date, including a couple handy ones. Coming along well at the trials and should be about the mark. WRITTEN REALITY (17) was okay first-up when chasing gamely into the placings. Strips fitter and is drawn cosy. Can play a role. SPIRIT OF TORQUE (16) returns. Showed promising signs in her debut prep, closing it off with two efforts at Listed level. Gets a key booking in Thompson and deserves obvious respect.
